$comment: One system, three densities. Office is a desk. Station is a Sunday kiosk. Portal is a phone. A component is written once and resolves these at runtime.

office.$use: Maria at a desk on a Tuesday. Dense, keyboard-first, calm.

station.$use: Ruth at check-in, Sunday 09:58, forty families queuing. Unmissable, fast, zero ambiguity.

portal.$use: A member on a phone for four minutes a week. Warm, simple, app-like.
